proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.two_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can target one object, but Sovereign Glue creates a bond between two objects at once. Modeling only one side would be false.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The rule's core payload is a persistent adhesive bond between objects. No existing effect atom represents joining two objects into a bonded state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.sets_after_duration
proposed_widenings.justification: The glue does not take effect immediately; it sets after 1 minute. The current activation family has ongoing duration, but no honest delayed-resolution/set timer for non-spell item activations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set.

notes: MagicItemRecord and activation economics already exist, and ounce stock could likely map to a nonrecharging charge pool with random initialCount. The blockers are the pairwise object attachment, the missing adhesive-bond effect, and the delayed set timing. I did not author content/magic_item_sovereign_glue.dhall because any valid JSON would omit the item's core mechanic.
